parameters.jsCode: return $input.all().map(({json: item}) => { const sourceUrl = String(item.link || ''); const url = new URL(sourceUrl); if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(url.protocol) || url.hostname !== 'uqu.edu.sa') throw new Error('Check the original UQU article URL'); const id = sourceUrl.match(/\/App\/News\/(\d+)/i)?.[1] || item.guid || item.id; if (!id) throw new Error('Stable original article ID is required'); const text = String(item.contentSnippet || item.description || item.content || '').replace(/<[^>]*>/g, ' ').trim(); const date = item.isoDate || item.pubDate; return {json: { university_slug: 'uqu', source_key: 'uqu-rss', source_id: String(id), source_url: sourceUrl, title: String(item.title || '').trim(), summary: text.slice(0, 5000), content_text: text.slice(0, 100000), published_at: date ? new Date(date).toISOString() : null, image_urls: [], pdf_urls: [], registration_links: [], category: 'general' }}; });
